name: subscribe_origin_ci
description: Subscribe this conversation to terminal Origin CI results on a repository, or on one branch of it. Waits until every check run on a commit is terminal, then delivers one commit-wide result: success when none failed, or failure with the failed check names. Only commits that are an open pull request's head are covered, so the branch scope matches PR head branches; CI on commits with no open PR does not produce events. Failures always deliver; a success delivers only as this subscription's first result or when it flips a previously delivered failure — repeated greens are not delivered. Subscribing to the repository's default branch (e.g. main) is one-shot: it delivers the next terminal result on that branch and then closes itself. To wait for a PR's CI, subscribe to the PR's head branch instead. After subscribing, state what you are waiting for and end your turn; the event arrives as a follow-up notification in this conversation.
